اصطخمت (form VIII)
# اِصْطَخَمْتُ (iṣṭaḵamtu) /isˤ.tˤa.xam.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِصْطَخَمَ (iṣṭaḵama)
# اِصْطَخَمْتَ (iṣṭaḵamta) /isˤ.tˤa.xam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِصْطَخَمَ (iṣṭaḵama)
# اِصْطَخَمْتِ (iṣṭaḵamti) /isˤ.tˤa.xam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِصْطَخَمَ (iṣṭaḵama)
# اِصْطَخَمَتْ (iṣṭaḵamat) /isˤ.tˤa.xa.mat/: thi
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
